messages:
Maya (PM): ok team — quick sync. Customer Z asked for a private deployment pilot next quarter. we need to lock an actionable decision lattice by EOD Friday: MVP scope vs SLA targets vs sequencing. can we call out the hard blockers?
Alex (Runtime): throughput baseline? what model sizes are they using? small Llama-2-13b or larger?
Maya (PM): they want 13b for now, maybe 70b later. target QPS ~40 p50 latency <= 150ms for short chat flows. storage of KV cache per-tenant required.
Sam (Infra): 40 QPS for dedicated private nodes is doable but needs prewarm slots + autoscale buffer. current slot pool math: 6 nodes of A100 gives ~35 QPS at 13b with continuous batching. we need +2 nodes or smarter scheduling.
Jordan (Security): flagged: customer requires HSM-backed keys + per-tenant audit logs retained 1y. also mandatory config review and SOC2 addendum.
Priya (Release): deployment sequence suggestion: staging canary -> internal beta -> customer pilot. but we need a rollback playbook and canary failure thresholds.
Alex (Runtime): if we add prefix/KV caching we can hit 150ms most requests. but cache warm-up for 13b will change initial percentiles. alternative: quantized 4-bit variant reduces memory, might allow fewer nodes.
Maya (PM): tradeoffs we need in lattice: feature set (embeddings, streaming, function-calls), SLA band (p50/p95), infra commit (nodes), security gating (HSM/audit), rollout order.
Sam (Infra): infra ask: clarify burst tolerance. If traffic is spiky we need burst pool or accept higher p95. which do we prefer?
Jordan (Security): can't waive HSM for pilot. KMS integration must be in staging. we can parallelize review if infra has the KMS integration stub ready.
Alex (Runtime): propose two paths: Path A (performant): full KV cache + quantized runtime + +2 nodes. Path B (conservative): no KV cache initially, 4-node commit, slower p95 but easier rollout.
Maya (PM): ok propose we map these to acceptance criteria in lattice: Path A -> SLA p50<=120ms p95<=450ms, requires infra +2 nodes, security gated (HSM ready). Path B -> SLA p50<=200ms p95<=800ms, infra 0 additional nodes, security still required but KMS can be queued.
Priya (Release): if we go Path A we need a canary flag gate per-customer and auto-fallback to hosted model (for customer calls) if infra saturation. can we build that in 2 weeks?
Sam (Infra): auto-fallback requires network routing + auth. we can wire a simple proxy rule in 1 week, but edge cases in metrics/traceback add more work.
Alex (Runtime): also need model-variant compatibility in the router (quantized vs full). runtime change to support on-the-fly fallback is ~3 dev-days plus testing.
Jordan (Security): timeline note — KMS/HSM cert path and audit collection will take ~10 working days if infra has the stub. recommend we start KMS hookup ASAP.
Maya (PM): action items: 1) Alex estimate for runtime fallback + quant variant testing (due Thu). 2) Sam finalize node delta + prewarm plan (Thu). 3) Jordan share KMS checklist + reviewer owners (Wed). 4) Priya draft rollback/canary thresholds (Thu). I'll assemble the lattice doc after these.
Alex (Runtime): ack, will post a short perf matrix into this thread when ready.
Sam (Infra): ack, I'll sketch cost delta and risk matrix.
Jordan (Security): pinging @Maya (PM) — adding compliance team reviewer: security-request-bot.
deploy-bot: new deployment ticket created — ID D-4821, links: https://releases/redwood/D-4821
Maya (PM): thanks — if everyone can drop one-line blockers in this thread by EOD we can finalize the lattice and communicate to Customer Z this week. :thumbsup:
Alex (Runtime): blocker: need perf data for 13b quantized under production prompt mix.
Sam (Infra): blocker: capacity commit requires approval from finance for +2 nodes.
Jordan (Security): blocker: audit retention storage estimate needed (rough number ok).
Priya (Release): blocker: tests for fallback and canary automation need infra sandbox access.
Maya (PM): noted — I'll chase finance and infra sandbox access. closing for now, will post the lattice doc after the estimates come in.
